_: Film d'accueil 45 s « bande-annonce » (19/10/2026). Texte validé par Kévin le 19/10 à 14 h 23 : « pourquoi nous et pas un autre terminal » (on trie, on publie nos résultats même quand on a tort, le niveau pro sans le prix pro). Le casting (branche bande-casting) a été lu avec la première version du texte.

lines.text: Tokyo ouvre. Londres prend le relais. New York fait trembler le monde.
Chaque jour, des milliers de chiffres. Les autres terminaux vous les donnent tous.
MACROARSENAL vous dit lesquels comptent. En direct.
lines.tts: Macro Arsenal vous dit lesquels comptent. En direct.

lines.text: Chaque matin, notre lecture des marchés. Chaque soir, le verdict, publié. Même quand on a tort.
Et avant chaque trade, Doji vérifie tout. Votre plan. Les niveaux. Le calendrier. Votre risque.
Toute la puissance des pros. Sans leur prix.
MACROARSENAL. Le terminal qui change votre vision du trading.
lines.tts: Macro Arsenal. Le terminal qui change votre vision du trading.

voices.label: FR, grave de cinéma
voices.design: A deep, powerful French male voice-over artist in his fifties, the iconic voice of French blockbuster movie trailers: a very low, resonant bass-baritone with a touch of gravel and immense authority. Perfect native Parisian French diction. Close-microphone professional voice-over studio sound, rich low end, natural breathing, human and alive, never robotic.

voices.label: FR, puissant et moderne

voices.label: FR, rauque et intense
voices.design: A French male voice-over artist in his forties with a dark, slightly husky, gritty deep voice, intense and magnetic, like the narrator of a high-stakes thriller trailer. Perfect native French diction. Close-microphone professional voice-over studio sound, rich low end, natural breathing, human and alive, never robotic.

voices.label: FR, motivation brute et vraie
voices.design: A French man in his late thirties with a deep, warm, slightly raspy voice, the narrator of viral motivational videos: real, raw and human, speaking from the heart with total conviction. Native Parisian French. Recorded close to a high-end studio microphone, natural breathing, real human texture and small imperfections, never robotic, never synthetic.
voices.acting: Deliver it like the voice-over of a viral motivational video: natural, human and conversational, never theatrical, never announcer-like. Speak with real conviction and energy, a lively, dynamic rhythm with short punchy pauses, stress the key words, and let the intensity build up to a powerful, inspiring last line. Sounds like a real person talking from the heart, never shouting.

Native Parisian French. Recorded close to a high-end studio microphone, natural breathing, real human texture and small imperfections, never robotic, never synthetic.
voices.acting: Deliver it like the voice-over of a viral motivational video: natural, human and conversational, never theatrical, never announcer-like. Speak with real conviction and energy, a lively, dynamic rhythm with short punchy pauses, stress the key words, and let the intensity build up to a powerful, inspiring last line. acting: Read it like an epic, cinematic movie trailer voice-over for a world-class product: slow, deep and powerful, with long dramatic pauses between sentences. Short sentences land like hammer blows. Low, resonant chest voice, quiet intensity that builds steadily towards the end; the final line is grand, confident and unforgettable. Never shouting, never rushed, every word crystal clear.
